task: binary classification of short peptides as IgE-binding (allergen, positive) vs non-binding (non-allergen); P(allergen) in [0, 1], called allergen at >= 0.5
output: score (0 at the decision boundary) and p_allergen = sigmoid(score). p_allergen is an uncalibrated monotone transform of the score, not a measured probability
weights_layout: ten fold files (five per member family, named mlp_fold0-4.joblib and cnn_fold0-4.pt) plus ensemble.json (score scales, decision threshold, training length range)
input: 20 uppercase standard amino acids, length 3-49 (the trained range); anything else is rejected

training_data.source: IEDB B-cell assay export, IgE-binding assays on peptides tested as themselves
training_data.filters: peptides shorter than 50 residues of the 20 standard amino acids; the tested antigen is the peptide itself; IgE binding measured; outcome Positive or Negative; no modified residues; methods ELISA, peptide microarray, immunoblot / dot blot, SPR; assay rows collapsed to unique peptides and peptides with conflicting Positive/Negative assays dropped (9,030 peptides); 91 embedding-space outliers then removed (8,939 peptides)
training_data.split: grouped by source allergen protein (peptides without one by CD-HIT cluster at 80% identity), class-stratified: 7,160 peptides in 5-fold cross-validation and 1,779 in a held-out test set; held-out peptides sharing an 8-mer with the training side are excluded from evaluation (1,581 evaluable, 482 allergen)
training_data.label_note: label 1 means IgE binding was observed in the assay, which is an epitope-level label, not a clinical allergy diagnosis

holdout_metrics.source: Models/Allergenicity/training.ipynb and export_deployment.py; the deployed weights were re-fitted with the notebook's own code and are scored on the evaluable hold-out peptides at the decision boundary
holdout_metrics.caveat: The notebook's cached cross-validated run scored AUC 0.7403 and MCC 0.4099; the re-fit is close to, not identical to, that run (score correlation 0.92). The numbers above are the ones for these weights. Sensitivity is low: at the default boundary fewer than half of the IgE-binding peptides are flagged.

limitations: Trained on 3-49 residue peptides from IgE-binding assays only; sequences outside that range are not scored.
p_allergen is not calibrated; the 0.5 boundary is the model's own class boundary, not a risk threshold.
Not trained on cosmetic or therapeutic peptides specifically.
